raw:
@c constraint
  var ?total int
  var ?per_person int
  var ?priya_owes int
  var ?others_owe int
  require ?total equal 186
  require ?per_person equal ?total divided_by 4
  require ?priya_owes equal ?per_person minus 50
  require ?others_owe equal ?per_person
  task prove
  select ?others_owe
